items.title: Trump says US-Iran ceasefire still in place after exchange of fire in Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran accuses the US of violating the truce, alleging it targeted an oil tanker and carried out attacks on coastal areas.

items.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of breaching Victory Day ceasefire
items.description: The two sides report responding to hundreds of drone attacks, just hours into a truce to cover celebrations of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany.

items.title: White House calls Mark Hamill 'sick' after actor's Trump grave post
items.description: The Star Wars actor apologised and deleted the post, which contained an AI image of the president in a shallow grave.

items.title: Three dead after volcano erupts on Indonesian island
items.description: Officials had previously issued warnings on climbing the active volcano due to safety concerns.

items.title: South Africa president faces call to resign after court ruling
items.description: The Constitutional Court says MPs were was wrong to block impeachment proceedings against Cyril Ramaphosa.

items.title: Third British national has suspected hantavirus infection, UK government says
items.description: The patient is on the remote Atlantic island of Tristan da Cunha, which was visited by the cruise ship in April.

items.title: US jet fuel could be used in Europe to ease possible shortages
items.description: An international air body suggests wider acceptance of US-grade jet fuel could help to head off any supply problems.

items.title: Anti-war protests rock Japan as PM pushes for stronger defence
items.description: Japan's largest anti-war protests in decades highlight a population divided over changes to its pacifist constitution.

items.title: Rebel Wilson accused of 'complete revision of history' as defamation case closes
items.description: The Bridesmaids star claims an actress retracted a complaint about sexual harassment by a producer.

items.title: Trump and Lula's private Oval Office meeting signals lingering strain - and effort to avoid tension
items.description: The US and Brazilian presidents did not appear together publicly, but traded compliments after their talks.

items.title: Two Islamic-State linked Australian women charged with crimes against humanity
items.description: A third woman who also returned to Australia from Syria was charged with joining a terrorist organisation.
